coucal.definition: n Old World ground-living cuckoo having a long dagger-like hind claw
coucal.translation: n. [鸟]褐翅鸦鹃(属杜鹃科,外形似雉)

couch.definition:
n. a flat coat of paint or varnish used by artists as a primer
n. a narrow bed on which a patient lies during psychiatric or psychoanalytic treatment
couch.translation:
n. 长沙发, 睡椅, 卧榻
vt. 横躺, 表达
vi. 躺下, 蹲伏

couch potato.translation: n. 花大量时间看电视的人, 电视迷; 美国人说整天看电视的人是“沙发土豆”

couchant.definition: s. lying on the stomach with head raised with legs pointed forward
couchant.translation: a. 俯伏的, 蹲着的, 抬头伏卧状的

couche.definition:
v. t. Not erect; inclined; -- said of anything that is usually
   erect, as an escutcheon.
v. t. Lying on its side; thus, a chevron couche is one which
   emerges from one side of the escutcheon and has its apex on the
   opposite side, or at the fess point.
couche.translation: [法]微微前倾的； 不是竖立着的

couched.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Couch
a. Same as Couch/.
couched.translation: vt. 表达（couch的过去式与过去分词形式）

couchee.definition:
v. t. A reception held at the time of going to bed, as by a
   sovereign or great prince.

coucher.definition:
n. One who couches.
n. One who couches paper.
n. A factor or agent resident in a country for traffic.
n. The book in which a corporation or other body registers
   its particular acts.

couches.definition:
n an upholstered seat for more than one person
n a flat coat of paint or varnish used by artists as a primer
n a narrow bed on which a patient lies during psychiatric or psychoanalytic treatment
v formulate in a particular style or language
couches.translation: n. 长沙发椅( couch的名词复数 ); 睡椅; （病人受检查时躺的）长榻; （尤指诊室内的）诊察台

couchette.definition: n. a compartment on a European passenger train; contains 4 to 6 berths for sleeping

couchettes.definition: n. a compartment on a European passenger train; contains 4 to 6 berths for sleeping
couchettes.translation: n. 睡铺, 有卧铺的车厢( couchette的复数形式 )

couching.definition: v formulate in a particular style or language
